description: The London Bridge limestone, Monaro district, New South Wales is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The London Bridge Limestone has been traced along its strike from a point five miles south-south-east of Queanbeyan to a point three miles south-east of Bredbo, a distance of forty miles. At London Bridge this formation attains its greatest development and a large-scale geological map of this area has been prepared. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are AU-NSW, Earth Sciences, GA Publication, Published_External, Record. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2026-01-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
